title: Police arrest 6 suspects, seize P1.28M ‘shabu’ in Caraga drug stings

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Police operatives confiscated over P1.28 million worth of suspected “shabu” (crystal meth) and arrested six suspects in a series of anti-narcotics operations across the Caraga Region on Tuesday, Nov. 17. In a statement on Wednesday, Police Regional Office 13 (PRO-13) director Brig. Gen. Rolindo Suguilon said the coordinated buy-bust stings yielded a total of 188.86 grams of shabu valued at P1,284,248.
